caption.text:
Penyidik Komisi Pemberantasan Korupsi (KPK) menahan mantan Sekretaris Jenderal Majelis Permusyawaratan Rakyat (MPR), Ma’ruf Cahyono, dalam dugaan gratifikasi pengadaan barang dan jasa di lingkungan Sekretariat Jenderal MPR RI.

Penahanan tersebut dilakukan seusai penyidik memeriksa Ma’ruf di gedung Merah Putih KPK, Jakarta Selatan, pada Kamis, 9 Juli 2026.

Baca selengkapnya di tempo.co dan link in bio.

#TUpdate #tempodotco #KPK #MPR
caption.text_translation:
Investigators of the Commission for Eradication of Corruption (KPK) arrested the former Secretary General of the Assembly of People's People's (MPR), Ma'ruf Cahyono, on suspicion of gratification of procurement of goods and services in the premises of the General Secretariat of MPR RI.

The arrest was made after investigators examined Ma'ruf in the Red and White building of KPK, South Jakarta, on Thursday, July 9, 2026.

Read more at tempo.co and link in bio.

 #TUpdate #tempodotco #KPK #MPR
